steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the washer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: WARNING — Electrical Shock Hazard. Disconnect power before servicing.

steps.title: Air trap and pressure hose clear
steps.body: Are tub-to-trap, trap-to-hose, and hose-to-APS connections secure with no kinks, leaks, or debris?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Are tub-to-trap, trap-to-hose, and hose-to-APS connections secure with no kinks, leaks, or debris?

branches.label: Hose/trap issue
branches.oemOutcome: Clear hose/air trap, repair routing, replace leaking hose; retest fill.

steps.title: Verify J14 at ACU
steps.body: Remove top/rear access as needed. Verify J14 fully seated and APS harness connected.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Remove top/rear access as needed. Verify J14 fully seated and APS harness connected.

steps.title: Harness continuity ACU to APS
steps.body: Is there continuity in the harness between ACU J14 and the water level sensor?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Is there continuity in the harness between ACU J14 and the water level sensor?

branches.label: Open harness
branches.oemOutcome: Repair or replace harness between ACU and APS.

steps.title: Restore power for APS supply
steps.body: Plug in washer for DC measurement at J14.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Plug in washer for DC measurement at J14.

steps.title: +5 VDC at J14 (pin 2 GND, pin 3 Vcc)
steps.body: Black probe to J14 pin 2 (GND), red to pin 3. Expect +5 VDC.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Black probe to J14 pin 2 (GND), red to pin 3. Expect +5 VDC.

testPoint.label: +5 VDC at J14 (pin 2 GND, pin 3 Vcc)

branches.label: +5 VDC present
branches.oemOutcome: Drain tub, replace water level sensor (APS).

branches.label: +5 VDC missing
branches.oemOutcome: Perform TEST #1 ACU Power Check; replace ACU if supply fault persists.

steps.title: Clear air trap/hose
steps.oemOutcome: Service pressure hose and air trap; retest.

steps.title: Replace water level sensor
steps.oemOutcome: Replace APS after confirming tub drained.
